ITEM 1 | Two rectangular slices side by side, each about 7 cm wide and 8 cm long, with a golden-tan crust edge at the top, a thick layer of bright red-orange sauce spotted across a pale melted white-yellow topping, slightly browned and glossy in places, sitting on a white plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Rectangular slice of similar size, about 7 cm by 8 cm, with thick golden crust along one edge, orange-red sauce and pale melted topping with some browned spots, sitting on a white plate next to the first slice | 130
ITEM 3 | Irregular lumpy mound about 4 cm by 5 cm and roughly 2.5 cm tall, dark olive-brown with greenish-grey flecks, matte and slightly crumbly surface, appears dense and not juicy, with small crumbs scattered nearby on the white plate | 50
